# Test fixtures

`red.jpg`, `red.png`, `blue.png` and `locked.pdf` are synthetic processing fixtures.

`portrait.jpg` is Google's public MediaPipe segmentation test image, retrieved from `https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/segmentation_input_rotation0.jpg`. It is used only for local automated testing, never as application content. MediaPipe source/license: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe (Apache 2.0). No user photos are included.

`readable-36-pages-2.5mb.pdf` is a synthetic 36-page text/image PDF generated by `scripts/create-pdf-regression-fixture.mjs`. Real vector text and a generated texture image exercise PDF preservation/rasterization; metadata padding brings the input to 2.50 MB. No user document or personal data is used.
